description_en: Queries the O\\&M task configurations of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的运维任务配置
name: DescribeActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

Config.description_en: The configuration details of the O\&M task
Config.description_zh: 运维任务的配置详情信息

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

CycleTime.description_en:
The interval between two O\&M tasks.

If the CycleType parameter is set to Month, the CycleTime parameter returns a string of numbers ranging from 1 to 28, which indicates the specific days of the month. The numbers are separated with commas (,). The CycleTime parameter returns 0 when the configurations do not take effect.
If the CycleType parameter is set to Week, the CycleTime parameter returns a string of numbers ranging from 1 to 7, which indicates the specific days of the week. The numbers are separated with commas (,). The CycleTime parameter returns 0 when the configurations do not take effect
CycleTime.description_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0

CycleType.description_en:
The unit of the O\&M task cycle. Valid values:

Month
Week
CycleType.description_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O\&M window. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the hh:mm:ss Z format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口结束时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O\&M window. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the hh:mm:ss Z format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口开始时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the last O\&M task configurations are modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 上一次修改运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the configurations take effect. Valid values:

1: The configurations are in effect.
2: The configurations are invalid
Status.description_zh:
配置是否生效。

1 生效
2 无效

HasConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether the O\&M task is configured. Valid values:

1: The O\&M task is configured.
0: The O\&M task is not configured
HasConfig.description_zh:
是否已配置：

1：已经配置；
0：未配置
